scope: John and Matthew, ENG/SPA/POR, lexical-concept anchors over normalized verse text

definition_boundary.semantic_scaffolding_cost: proposed operational construct: description/decoder/exceptions required to recover intended relations at declared fidelity
definition_boundary.conditional_semantic_uncertainty: H(M | expression, context), conceptual target for later estimation

per_language_structural_baseline.interpretation: tight clustering is expected to be strongly influenced by identical record count/reference schema; it is not evidence of a universal semantic constant

important_negative: COMPASSION and MERCY are useful Matthew-side concepts but were not lexical cross-book anchors in John under this heuristic; forcing them as universal seeds would add decoder/inference cost.
linguistic_boundary: multiword expressions and polysemy must be atomic or context-bound where needed: white spirit != spirit level != spirit drink; one-word dictionaries are insufficient.
next_gate: manual/embedding annotation for latent compassion/mercy actions; phrase-level idiom dictionary; estimate MDL/scaffold cost and fidelity; remove fixed schema overhead before testing cross-language semantic invariance
